location_anchors.prompt_summary: Vast stretches of jet-black obsidian sand meeting crashing white ocean waves. Dark hexagonal basalt rock stacks line the jagged shoreline under heavy leaden clouds. Warm golden sunlight breaks along the misty horizon over cold slate-blue ocean waters.

A massive 60-meter high waterfall plunging off a sheer cliff face of dark vertical hexagonal basalt columns. Pure white cascading water falls into a deep mossy canyon riverbed. Soft arctic fog and fine mist drift across damp emerald moss and dark volcanic rock faces.

A glassy mirror-still ocean fjord enclosed by towering, steep mountainsides dusted with snow and green moss. Wisps of white morning mist drift softly across the dark blue water surface. Pale dawn light creates subtle amber and pink reflections across the landscape.

A long jagged fissure in cracked dark basalt crust oozing rivers of incandescent orange and yellow lava. Thick plumes of white sulfur steam rise into twilight air, illuminated from below by heat. Crusted dark silver obsidian plates fracture to reveal liquid magma channels.
